--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地音乐播放器插件：树形歌单、直接流式播放、零 token 消耗
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-music-local

DeepSeek Harness 的**本地音乐播放器**插件。把一个音乐根目录下的**每个子目录（树形，任意深度）当成一个播放列表**，直接流式播放，不改动、不转存、不读取音频文件头。

设计目标：**零 token 消耗**。

> 要求：DSH `>= 0.2.0`、Node `>= 20`。可选依赖 `ffmpeg`（仅 dts / dsd / ape 这类需要转码的格式用到）。


---

## 为什么是零 token

插件刻意**不**做下面任何一件事：

| 常见做法 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.tools.register(...)` 注册 `music_play` 之类的模型工具 | ❌ 不注册 |
| `ctx.systemPrompt.section(...)` 往系统提示里塞音乐库清单 | ❌ 不注入 |
| `inject: ['llm', 'tools', 'systemPrompt']` | ❌ 只 `inject: ['webServer']` |
| 把曲库内容塞进对话上下文 | ❌ 完全不进上下文 |

因此它**不会出现在模型的工具列表里，也不会撑大系统提示**。音乐库的浏览、搜索、播放、切歌全部发生在**浏览器半体 ↔ 宿主 HTTP 路由**之间，与 LLM 毫无关系。无论你放 38 首歌还是 3.8 万首歌，每轮对话的 token 开销都是 **0**。

---

## 安装

先在 profile 目录里把插件装成依赖（下面三种方式任选其一）。

**方式 A — 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐）**

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add github:xiao000xue/dsh-music-local
```

**方式 B — 已经有本地源码副本**

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add file:D:/dsh-plugins/dsh-music-local
```

**方式 C — 完全不用包管理器**

把本仓库整个目录复制到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-music-local`。
插件不依赖任何第三方运行时库，有 `lib/` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 就能跑。

装好之后，在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把插件挂进 `bundles`，然后重启 DSH：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-music-local": "github:xiao000xue/dsh-music-local"   // ← ① 依赖（随安装方式而定）
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ... 其它 bundle ...
        "dsh-music-local"                                     // ← ② 挂载
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

profile 位于 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile名>/package.json`（桌面端通常是 `desktop`）。

插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会被自动读取（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明），**无需手改 profile 的 patch 文件**。

> 用 `file:` 依赖时，`node_modules` 里是源目录的副本 —— 改了源码要重新 `pnpm install` 才生效。
> 想改一行看一行，直接用 `node_modules/dsh-music-local` 里那份改，或改用 junction/symlink。


---

## 使用

重启 DSH 后：

* **输入框下方**出现一条**播放条** —— 上一首 / 播放暂停 / 下一首 / 进度 / 音量 / 打开面板。
* 点右侧按钮展开**播放面板**（浮层，可拖动、可缩放，位置记在 `localStorage`）：
  * 左栏 = **树形歌单**：音乐根目录下的**每个子目录（任意深度）**都是一个歌单节点，
    ▸/▾ 逐层展开收起（展开状态记在 `localStorage`），歌单名右侧的数字是该文件夹（含子文件夹）的曲目数；
  * 右栏 = 选中歌单的曲目，支持搜索框过滤（在哪个歌单里搜就只搜它的子树）；
  * 点一行 = 播放（再点当前这首歌 = 播放/暂停），**双击 = 从头播放**；
  * 顶部 = 设置，可改音乐根目录、重扫。

面板里 `右键 / 悬停` 曲目可以看到解析出的「歌手 - 歌名」。

---

## 设置的存放位置

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `$DSH_HOME/music-local.json` | 音乐根目录、扫描开关等 |
| `$DSH_HOME/music-local-prefs.json` | 上次播放曲目、播放模式、音量 |

`$DSH_HOME` 即 DSH 的数据目录（桌面端由机器级环境变量 `DSH_HOME` 指定）。

---

## 格式支持

分成两条路：

**① 浏览器原生可播**（直接给出 `206 Partial Content` + `Range`，秒开、可任意拖动）

```
mp3  m4a  m4b  m4r  aac  flac  wav  ogg  oga  opus  webm
aif  aiff aifc alac  mp4  caf  3gp
```

**② 需要 ffmpeg 实时转码**（dts / dsd / ape 这类浏览器不认的格式）

```
dts  dff  dsf  ape  wma  asf  wv   tta  mpc  tak  ofr
ac3  eac3 amr  au   snd  mid  midi spx  m4p
mkv  avi  mov  flv  rm   rmvb wmv  mpg  mpeg ts  vob
```

转码走**管道**，不落盘：`ffmpeg -i <文件> -f s16le -`，边解边送。
已探到时长时会在上方拼一个**定长 WAV 头**，于是 `Range` 请求能换算成 `-ss 秒数`，**拖动进度条可用**；探不到时长则回退为流式 WAV（能播，但不能精确拖动）。

### ffmpeg 自动挑选

机器上可能装了好几份 `ffmpeg.exe`，其中不少是**精简版**（`--disable-everything`，只认识 mp4/mp3/flv），拿它转 dts 会直接 `Invalid data found when processing input`。

插件启动后会在常见位置搜 ffmpeg 并**打分**：

* `-muxers` 里有 `E s16le` → +4（能输出裸 PCM，转码才可用）
* `-demuxers` 里有 `dts` / `dsf` / `dff` / `ape` / `asf` / `avi` → 每项 +1

得分最高的那份才会被用来转码，且会被**真实解码验证**。找不到或只有精简版时，面板「设置」里会明确标注是 `完整版` / `精简版` / `未找到 ffmpeg`，第 ① 类格式依旧正常播放。

---

## 性能

* **扫描**：只解析文件名，**不读文件头**。3.8 万个文件约 **3 秒**。
* **缓存**：扫描结果常驻内存，只做一次；之后所有请求都是内存命中（`/manifest`、`/tracks` 从 ~3.2 s 降到个位数毫秒）。
* **列表渲染**：15k 行用原生 DOM + 分页（默认 300 条一页），不走 React 重渲染，滚动不掉帧。
* **曲名解析**：文件名里 `歌名-歌手` 与 `歌手-歌名` 混着来。用「**配对对象去重计数**」判定 —— 歌名只会配对到一个歌手，歌手会配对到很多歌名。比纯词频稳，能扛住「车载合辑里大量重名文件」这种脏数据。

---

## HTTP 路由一览

宿主半体注册在前缀 `/dsh-music-local` 下：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/config` | 根目录、曲库统计、ffmpeg 探测状态 |
| POST | `/config` | 改根目录并重扫 |
| GET | `/manifest` | 播放列表 + 曲目清单（紧凑编码） |
| POST | `/rescan` | 强制重扫 |
| GET | `/tracks` | 分页取曲目（`?ids=1` 取 id 列表，`?q=` 过滤） |
| GET | `/track` | 单曲详情 |
| GET | `/browse` | 浏览目录（用于设置里选根目录） |
| GET | `/probe` | 探测时长 |
| GET | `/stream/<id>` | 音频流（支持 `Range`；转码轨用 `?t=<秒>&d=<时长>`） |
| GET/POST | `/prefs` | 播放偏好读写 |

---

## 已知限制

* 转码轨的精确拖动依赖「能探到时长」，个别损坏文件的时长探测会失败，此时该曲不能精确 seek。
* 精简版 ffmpeg 只能转 mp4/mp3 类，第 ② 类格式会播不了 —— 面板会提示，放一份完整版 ffmpeg 到常见路径即可。
* 播放器不使用音频可视化（`createMediaElementSource` 在 DSH 里会导致静音），这是有意的取舍。

---

MIT

plugins.description: Automatic same-session continuation, retry with backoff, goal revival, and restart recovery for the DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-autocontinue

A dsh plugin that keeps a session working when nobody is watching: it continues
the conversation on its own, retries through provider and network failures with
backoff, and refuses to let a goal session stall.

**Version 0.1.13** · verified on `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2`.

- [Why](#why)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Behaviour](#behaviour)
  - [1. Continuation](#1-continuation)
  - [2. Retry through outages](#2-retry-through-outages)
  - [3. Goal revival](#3-goal-revival)
- [Working with the goal round driver](#working-with-the-goal-round-driver)
- [Visibility](#visibility)
- [Commands](#commands)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Install and update](#install-and-update)
- [Hard-won notes](#hard-won-notes)

## Why

A long unattended run dies in three boring ways: the model stops after one turn
and waits for a human; the uplink drops and the turn ends in `TRANSPORT`; or a
goal quietly loses its activation edge — the round driver disarms a goal on
error, and a session resume or fork deliberately leaves it disarmed. The work is
still perfectly resumable in all three cases. This plugin resumes it.

## What it does

| | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| **Continues** | An armed session's idle agent gets the next round queued for it, instead of waiting for a human to type "continue". |
| **Retries** | A turn that failed on the provider or network is retried forever by default, with exponential backoff that plateaus at a constant 5-minute interval. |
| **Revives** | A goal that stopped being driven — disarmed after a failure, left disarmed by a resume/fork, or paused — is re-armed so the objective keeps moving. |

Nothing runs until a session is **armed** (see [Quick start](#quick-start)).

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. install into a profile (see Install and update for the why-tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-autocontinue-0.1.4.tgz

# 2. arm the current session, from the session itself
/autocontinue on
```

Goal sessions arm themselves (`goalSessions: true`). Profiles that launch
sessions rather than a human — cron, headless, "called in" — set
`enabled: true` and get it for every session in that profile.

## Behaviour

### 1. Continuation

When an armed session's agent goes idle, the plugin queues a round: a normal user
message headed `<autocontinue> Round n/…` that tells the model to keep going, to
treat the workspace and tool results as authoritative, and to end its reply with
the done marker when the assignment is genuinely finished. The transcript reads
as an ordinary conversation.

The loop stops when any of these is true: the model ends a reply with the done
marker (`AUTOCONTINUE: DONE`), a turn is aborted (you hit stop — a human
interrupt is respected), `maxRounds` is reached, or you run `/autocontinue off`.

### 2. Retry through outages

Defaults are tuned for an unreliable uplink — retry **forever**, backing off to a
constant 5-minute interval:

| Consecutive failure | Wait before the retry |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 15 s |
| 2 | 30 s |
| 3 | 60 s |
| 4 | 2 min |
| 5 | 4 min |
| 6+ | **5 min, forever** (unless `maxRetries` is set) |

Each retry round names the exact failure and instructs the model to retry the
action that failed rather than restart completed work. Set `maxRetries` to give
up after N, or leave it at `0` to ride out an outage of any length.

Two implementation facts that matter if you touch this code:

- The retry is driven by `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'error'` — the turn
  boundary that owns a failed request, carrying the harness's structured
  `LlmFailure` (`TRANSPORT`, `AUTH`, …).
- `agent/error` is deliberately **not** counted. A failed turn emits
  `agent/error` first and then `turn/end` with the same failure; counting both
  burned two retry credits per outage, so `maxRetries: 2` gave up after a single
  real retry. `turn/end` is the only counter.

### 3. Goal revival

A goal stops being driven for reasons unrelated to the objective, and a stalled
goal is worse than a failed turn because nothing retries it:

- the round driver **disarms** a goal on `agent/error`, so one network blip ends
  the goal's own continuation;
- a session **resume or fork** leaves an active goal disarmed by design (the
  driver never revives work on its own);
- the goal can be **paused**.

With `reviveGoals: true` (default), the plugin calls the sanctioned
`ctx.goals.resume(agent, ref)` — which carries no caller-authority gate — and the
goal round driver immediately takes the rounds back, keeping the goal's own
round accounting authoritative.

Deliberately **not** revived:

- **`blocked`** — that is the model, or the goal-tool policy, stating the work
  cannot proceed. Overriding it would fight the harness's own repeated-blocking
  policy.
- A goal whose **round budget is spent** — `resume` would throw; `maxGoalRounds`
  is the goal's decision to make, not this plugin's.

Revivals are capped by `maxGoalRevives` (default 5) so something that keeps
pausing a goal cannot ping-pong with it forever; the counter resets as soon as
the goal actually starts a round. Every revival is announced in the chat.

### 4. Restart recovery

A server swap (the `dsh-update` staged install + reload) or a crash stops the
process while a turn is still open: the persisted log ends inside `turn/start`
with no `turn/end`, and no live agent is left to continue it. On startup this
plugin scans the session corpus, and for every recently-written log that still
ends inside a turn it reopens the session through the same path the Web GUI uses
(`resolveAgent`) and queues a resume round.

That does three things the browser cannot be relied on for:

- the harness appends its synthetic `interrupted` closers, so the old turn is
  balanced instead of looking like a permanently running one;
- the session's agent preset and model selection are recomposed, and the goal
  round driver picks the work back up for a goal session;
- sessions with no browser tab still continue, which is what keeps a switch from
  orphaning work in another workspace.

The resumed session is told exactly what happened so it does not spend a round
working it out: the notice and the resume round name the durable cut
(`turn N, step M`), say the interruption was infrastructure — an update or a
crash — rather than a verdict on the plan, and tell the model not to investigate
it or re-plan from scratch. A goal session gets the same explanation as an
autocontinue notice riding the goal round.

The scan also reconstructs what the dead process owned, because a resumed model
cannot know it from the transcript alone:

- **Pending input.** The harness durably cancels queued inbox messages when the
  process disposes, so a message typed during a turn disappears on restart. The
  scan replays the raw `agent/inbox/spliced` history and re-queues messages
  canceled at that shutdown, deduped against input that is still pending or was
  already admitted (a steer move appears as a cancel plus a re-insert). The
  last handled cancellation seq is persisted per session, so a tab that
  reattaches and appends a fresh `session/end-seed` before the scan cannot hide
  the shutdown cancel behind a new resume marker.
- **Background jobs.** `job/registered` minus `job/settled` from the same
  generation is listed in the resume round. The processes are gone; naming them
  is what lets the model decide what to re-launch.
- **Subagent sessions.** Direct children of the resumed session created in the
  same generation are listed, so their work is not silently orphaned.
- **Active goals.** A session whose latest `goal/change` is `phase: active` with
  rounds left is reopened even when its last turn completed, so the goal round
  driver keeps the objective moving instead of leaving it parked until someone
  opens the workspace. Paused, blocked and complete goals are left alone.

Only logs modified within `resumeWindowMs` are considered, at most `resumeMax`
sessions are resumed per startup, and each session's failure is contained and
logged.

A resume notice looks like:

```
[autocontinue] dsh server restarted mid-run (turn 3, step 12); background jobs
from the old process are gone — c

plugins.description: Independent ChatGPT subscription provider for DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC). Native model and reasoning selection, tools, and no core patches.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-openai-oauth

**Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness Desktop through official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC).**

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![Verify](https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth/actions/workflows/verify.yml)

Independent community plugin; not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek. This is **not** the legacy fixed-client Codex OAuth/backend-api integration.

## Features

- Continue with ChatGPT, dynamic Agent registration, persistent host identity, and verified ID Tokens.
- Account-specific models and reasoning levels in **DSH's existing model selector**.
- Public Responses streaming, local function tools, tool results, and compatible history replay.
- Multiple saved account/workspace registrations, explicit account selection, rotating refresh, and scoped sign-out.
- Keeps DeepSeek Account, API-key providers, other sources, and existing sessions independent. No silent billing fallback.
- Stable account/session-scoped Responses affinity for cache reuse, without sending raw session identifiers.
- No Codex CLI, API key, patched ASAR, or replacement pi-ai installation.

## Compatibility

Validated Desktop releases: **0.2.1-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2**. Development/install helpers require Node.js **24+**.

Forward-eligible range: `0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. Later 0.2.x releases are **candidates, not validated releases**: installation and direct-update startup require isolated native checks before real-account activation. Next-minor prereleases/final, mixed components and failed contracts are rejected. See [forward compatibility](docs/forward-compatibility.md).

| Environment                                      | Status                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2                       | Native suites pass; initial UI recovery confirmed; hardened-startup recheck pending            |
| Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.1 (0.2.0-rc.2 baseline) | Previously validated native suites and desktop source/account/selection                        |
| macOS Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.1            | Native and real desktop validation pending for these releases; 0.2.0-rc.2 native suites passed |
| Windows/macOS/Linux Node CI                      | Protocol/package tests only; not proof of desktop login or inference                           |
| Older DSH, remote/headless Hosts, Linux Desktop  | Not currently claimed supported                                                                |

See [compatibility and verification](docs/compatibility.md). Do not bypass compatibility contracts or upgrade bundled framework dependencies to force compatibility.

## Install from source

No npm publication is required or currently promised.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth.git
cd dsh-openai-oauth
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:package
npm run doctor
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop add -w .
```

The `dsh` helper discovers the installed desktop executable and invokes its own bundled CLI; it does not install another Host. Use `DSH_APP` for a nonstandard installation. See [installation](docs/install.md) for Windows PowerShell and macOS examples.

Only restart DSH after running tasks have finished. A window close may hide the application to the tray; use its normal Quit action.

### Use a reviewed archive

For a clean/archive installation only. If the package is already linked to a checkout, keep it linked and use native `add -w` from the reviewed checkout instead; do not remove then install an archive over the Junction. See the [safe linked-update procedure](docs/install.md#updating-a-linked-checkout-safely).

```sh
npm run pack
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop add ./artifacts/pyh-pan-dsh-openai-oauth-0.3.3.tgz
```

Do not keep the old private bundle and this bundle enabled simultaneously: they deliberately preserve the same provider/credential identity. See [migration](docs/migration.md).

## Sign in and use

1. Open **Settings → Models → ChatGPT subscription**.
2. Click **Continue with ChatGPT**, then open the official authorization link in your browser.
3. Name/approve the Agent on OpenAI's page. Finish authentication yourself; never copy tokens from another client.
4. Read the first-use notice and select **Use this account**. Signing in alone does not switch your conversation's model.
5. Select **ChatGPT Subscription** in the existing model picker. Its **Reasoning level** submenu shows only choices advertised by that model.
6. Use **Manage usage** to review the Agent, quota, limits, and access at [ChatGPT Settings → Usage](https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage).

Accounts without the granted direct-inference scope remain signed in but disabled for inference. Explicitly enable subscription inference to request consent again. Reauthorization reuses the registration; adding a different account is a separate action.

## Limits and security

- Models, reasoning choices and quota are account/server dependent, not an unlimited or universal model entitlement.
- Currently advertises **text input** and client function tools. Direct image/file upload and hosted MCP/tool-search are not implemented.
- Explicit `maxTokens`/`temperature` remain rejected under this provider's conservative SIWC preview contract, not silently ignored; clear them before ordinary chat. DSH's built-in capped summarizer needs the separately reviewed [SIWC compaction replacement](docs/compaction.md)—updating this provider alone does not change a preset.
- Subscription failures never switch to an API-key/balance provider.
- Tokens stay in the native Host credentials service, not browser storage or ordinary plugin settings. Native local storage is not a promise of OS-keychain encryption.
- Sign-out attempts remote revocation and clears this account's local tokens, retaining its registration. Unconfirmed remote revocation is reported; review access in ChatGPT settings.
- Read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), [protocol design](docs/protocol.md), and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Development

```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:package
npm run test:native
npm run test:race
npm run test:compaction # optional compaction hook: Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 only
```

Pure tests use generated identities and mock upstreams. Native tests use an installed DSH and **temporary** credentials; they do not read your grant or spend inference quota. Real-account desktop validation is separately documented and always user-controlled.

Source is published directly as ESM; no generated `lib/` or vendor snapshot is necessary. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Update / remove

If both the source and authorization settings disappear after a DSH upgrade, check [version compatibility troubleshooting](docs/install.md#missing-source-and-authorization-settings-after-a-dsh-upgrade) before signing in again. An incompatible bundle is skipped before its code runs.

For a linked checkout, review/pull changes, run checks, then restart DSH safely. For an archive, install the reviewed replacement using the native plugin command. To remove:

```sh
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop remove @pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth
```

Removal preserves stored credentials. If you want to disconnect this Agent, sign out or manage access in ChatGPT settings first; do not delete the entire DSH profile.

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-client-ui-notes · DSH 笔记插件

在 DeepSeek Harness 里充当**备忘录 + 目录阅读器**的插件：左侧栏一个「笔记」按钮，
点开后中间主面板切换成阅读器 —— 左边文件夹树 + 置顶区，右边浏览器式 tab 栏，
支持 Markdown 左编辑右实时预览、txt 单栏编辑。

> 纯外部插件：只通过官方 Slot 机制接入，**不改动 DSH 任何源码**。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 左侧栏入口 | 「笔记」按钮排在会话栏上方的全局面板按钮区，默认顺序 30 |
| 浏览器式 tab 栏 | 切换、`×` 关闭、中键关闭、`+` 新建；未保存时显示小圆点；**按住标签拖动可调整顺序**（顺序会保存） |
| 文件夹树 | 可选任意文件夹作为根，目录懒加载展开，当前文件高亮；根目录按「文件夹 / 根目录文件」分组 |
| 隐藏项过滤 | 不展示 `.` 开头的文件/目录（`.git`、`.obsidian` 等）与 `node_modules`，但不禁止访问 |
| 切换文件夹 | 左侧最上方是**下拉**：当前目录 + 最近用过的目录（每项右侧 × 可移除，只删记录）+「选择其他文件夹…」调起 DSH 原生目录选择器。历史最多 8 条并会持久化 |
| 文件名搜索 | 置顶区下方的搜索框：输入即列出当前目录下文件名匹配的文件，上下键移动、回车或点击选中 —— 自动展开树中所在目录并滚过去高亮，同时在右侧打开 |
| 技能浏览（可关） | 文件夹下拉里的「浏览技能…」（未选文件夹时引导页也有入口）。列表本身是一个**单例标签页**，点进某个技能后左边的「技能」tab 仍在，点一下就能返回列表：列出当前可用的全部 skill，点一条就在阅读器里看它的全文。列表 = **按 DSH 约定扫描磁盘**（项目 / 用户 / 自定义根）+ **官方注册表补充**（内置技能），支持按名称/说明筛选。插件内置的技能标「内置」，正文由 DSH 提供，显示为**只读**视图。整体**只读**，不启用/禁用、不改文件。列表分「系统内置」与「我的技能」两块 |
| 置顶区 | 最多 6 个；1 个占满整行、2 个并排、更多自动往下延伸。有独立分隔线，与文件树分区 |
| 置顶操作 | hover 文件行点右侧图钉，或点已置顶胶囊上的 `×` 取消 |
| 置顶排序 | **按住置顶项拖动即可调整顺序**，拖动时其他项实时让位、并显示落点指示线；顺序与单双栏偏好在重启后保留 |
| 置顶排版 | 「置顶」标题右侧的开关在**双栏 / 单栏**间切换：双栏省纵向空间，单栏文件名更完整 |
| 删除文件 | 文件行右键 → 删除 → 二次确认；移入**系统回收站**可再取回。（Windows 不提供，见「兼容性」） |
| 定位文件 | 文件行右键 → **在访达中打开**（macOS）/ **打开文件所在位置**（Windows）/ 在文件管理器中显示（Linux），由系统打开所在文件夹 |
| 树内定位 | 文件树标题栏的准星按钮：**一键展开当前打开文件所在的所有文件夹并滚过去高亮**，文件夹层级再深也不用一层层点 |
| 树批量折叠 | 标题栏的「打开所有文件夹 / 收起所有文件夹」两个按钮，一次展开或收拢整棵树（超大目录树到 500 个文件夹会提示已截断） |
| 拖拽移动 | 拖文件到文件夹上即移动进去，也可拖回文件树空白处移回根目录；悬停 600ms 自动展开目标文件夹，可拖进多层 |
| Markdown | 左侧编辑、右侧实时预览（用官方 `MarkdownText`，GFM + 代码高亮 + 安全过滤） |
| 显示方式 | 编辑 / 分栏 / **仅预览** 三段切换；仅预览时编辑框完全不渲染，纯阅读更清爽 |
| 同步滚动 | 两侧按比例联动；工具栏可一键关闭，关闭后各自独立滚动 |
| 自适应宽度 | 面板变窄时自动收起文件夹栏、改为上下堆叠，避免内容被挤成一列字 |
| 层级分明 | 文件夹栏是内缩的圆角区块；macOS 折叠会话栏后，**只有左栏**额外下移让开交通灯，右侧阅读区（tab 栏 + 正文）保持不动，避免顶部露出空白带 |
| 纯文本 | txt 单栏直接编辑，不显示无意义的预览栏 |
| 新建 | 先选类型（Markdown / 纯文本），再填文件名；自动补扩展名 |
| 手动保存 | `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` 或保存按钮；未保存时 tab 有圆点、文档头显示「未保存」 |
| 状态记忆 | tab、当前 tab、置顶、展开的目录、滚动位置、未保存草稿、文件夹历史都会保留 |
| 卸载不留痕 | 卸载本插件时自动清掉这些本地记录，不会在下次安装时「复活」旧路径 |
| 标签页管理 | tab 上右键可「关闭 / 关闭其他 / 关闭右侧标签页 / 关闭全部」；中键关闭 |
| 标签溢出 | 标签多到放不下时，栏右端出现向下尖头，点开下拉列出全部标签（含被裁掉的），当前项高亮 |
| 文件可见范围 | 文件树标题行有「可编辑 / 全部」开关（偏好持久化）。「可编辑」只列能在阅读器里打开的文件；「全部」连 `.doc`/`.pdf` 一起列出 |
| 打开方式 | 点这类不可预览的文件**不会直接弹出系统程序**，而是在阅读区开一个标签页：显示「此格式无法在阅读器中打开」+ 一个**打开方式**控件。左边按钮用默认应用打开，右边下拉列出系统里所有能打开它的应用，底部另有「显示文件位置」 |

## 安装

> **前置条件：本插件是图形界面插件**，只在 **Web GUI** 里有界面 —— 包括桌面应用，
> 以及终端里自己跑起来的 `dsh web`（浏览器访问）。
> 纯终端场景（`dsh headless "..."`、SDK、ACP）装了不会报错，但也**没有任何功能可用**：
> 界面所依赖的槽位与 `webServer` 服务都由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 提供。

**桌面应用目前只发布 macOS 与 Windows 版，没有 Linux 版。** Linux 用户需要自行安装
DSH CLI，再用 `dsh web` 在浏览器里使用（功能与桌面版一致）。

### 桌面应用（macOS / Windows）

在左侧栏打开**「插件」面板** → 点**「添加插件」** → 填入包名 `dsh-client-ui-notes` → 安装。

> 注意不是「设置 → 内置插件」那一页 —— 那页只用于**查看**本部署内置了哪些插件，不能安装。

### 终端 / 自建 profile（任意平台，含 Linux）

先建一个带 Web 界面的 profile，再把插件装进去：

```sh
# 1. 以 web 模板创建 profile（--dump-config 让它只建不启动，配置输出丢弃即可）
dsh --profile notes --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null

# 2. 把插件装进该 profile
dsh plugin --profile notes add dsh-client-ui-notes

# 3. 启动，然后在浏览器里打开它打印的地址
dsh --profile notes web
```

左侧栏出现「笔记」图标即为安装成功。

> ⚠️ **不要跳过第 1 步。** 直接 `dsh plugin add` 会让 DSH 自动创建一个以
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 为基础的 profile，而 **base 里没有 Web 界面层**
> （`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。那样的 profile 启动 `web` 时界面出不来，
> 插件自然也无从显示。
>
> ⚠️ 也不能用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 去装桌面应用的 profile：
> 那个 profile 归应用独占管理，命令行写入会被拒绝
> （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
> 桌面版请用上面的「插件」面板。

想确认插件层已登记，可以看合并后的配置：

```sh
dsh --profile notes --dump-config | grep -A2 dsh-client-ui-notes
# # == dsh-client-ui-notes
# - id: ui-notes
#   name: dsh-client-ui-notes
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile notes remove dsh-client-ui-notes
```

### 首次使用

插件初始没有任何笔记目录，需要两步：

1. 点左上角的**文件夹按钮**选一个目录作为笔记根目录；
2. 右侧文件树标题行的可见范围开关默认是「**可编辑**」（只列 `.md`/`.txt` 等能在阅读器里打开的文件）。
   想看 `.doc`/`.pdf` 这类文件就切到「**全部**」。

### 开发者方式（本地改动 + 热链接）

```sh
# 1. 构建
cd ~/dsh-notes-plugin
npm install          # 首次
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json
node scripts/build-client.mjs

# 2. 链接进目标 profile（以 desktop 为例）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
ln -sfn ~/dsh-notes-plugin node_modules/dsh-client-ui-notes
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 里登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-client-ui-notes": "link:/Users/你/dsh-notes-plugin" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-client-ui-notes" ] } }
}
```

重启 DSH 后，左侧栏出现「笔记」按钮。

> 用 `link:` 装的插件，**改了 `lib/` 下的产物必须重启 DSH** 才会生效：客户端产物是启动时
> 读取并缓存的，磁盘文件变化不会自动重载。

## 更新

三条路都能升级，效果一样：

| 方式 | 怎么用 |
|---|---|
| 插件详情页的「更新」 | 侧栏「插件」→ 点本插件卡片 → 顶部按钮。发现新版本后点一下即升（**0.1.7 起才真正可用**） |
| 插件市场 | 市场里搜到本插件后点「更新」 |
| 命令行 | `dsh plugin --profile <名字> add dsh-client-ui-notes@latest` |

每个版本改了什么见 [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md)。

> **从 0.1.6 及更早升上来时，详情页的「更新」按钮必然失败**：带 HMR 的宿主会在跑
> pnpm 之前就以 `already-installed` 拒绝「覆盖安装自己」，而旧版本正是这么做的。
> 需要**手动升级一次**（市场或插件页装到 0.1.7+），之后这个按钮才通。
>
> 手动升级若被 pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge`（新版本观察期）拦下，用**插件市场**装：
> 它会自动往 profile 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` 追加放行规则，失败还会带
> `--config.minimum-release-age=0` 重试一次；插件页那条路没有这两个兜底。

## 工程结构

```
src/
  index.ts              Host 半边：文件读写路由 + 信任围栏
  client/
    index.tsx           插件入口：注册左侧栏按钮与主面板
    NotesPanel.tsx      面板 UI：树、置顶、tab 栏、编辑器
    store.ts            状态仓库 + localStorage 持久化（记忆功能）
    api.ts              Host 路由的浏览器端客户端
    styles.ts           样式（全部走 DSH 主题 token）
scripts/
  build-client.mjs      客户端 bundle 打包
cordis.patch.yml        profile 补丁：把插件插入插件名册
```

## 安全设计

Host 半边注册的路由能真实读写磁盘，因此：

- **信任围栏**：只接受 loopback 来源（校验 socket 地址 + Host 头 + 浏览器同源标记），
  拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，防 CSRF。
- **根目录约束**：每个请求都要带 `root`（用户显式选中的文件夹），目标路径必须落在
  root 之内，`../` 穿越与相对路径一律拒绝。
- **原子写**：先写同目录临时文件再 `rename`，不会出现半个文件。
- **删除可恢复**：删除优先移入**系统回收站**（macOS `~/.Trash`、Linux XDG 回收站），
  用户在文件管理器里能直接找回；系统回收站不可用时（如 Windows）回退到笔记根目录下的
  `dsh-notes-trash/`，该目录在文件树里可见，同样能取回。任何情况下都不是真删。
- **只允许 md/txt 新建**，文件名里禁止路径分隔符。

## 兼容性

### 操作系统

**怎么跑起一个有界面的 DSH** 各平台不同：

| | macOS | Windows | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| 桌面应用 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ 官方未发布 |
| 自建 `dsh web` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 插件运行环境 | 两者皆可 | 两者皆可 | 只能自建 |

插件功能各平台的差异：

| 能力 | macOS | Windows | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| 阅读器功能（树、标签页、编辑、预览、置顶、拖拽） | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 「打开方式」控件 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **删除文件** | 系统「废纸篓」 | ❌ **不提供**（见下） | XDG 回收站 |
| 顶部避让窗口控件 | 生效 | 不触发（无此需求） | 不触发 |

**为什么 Windows 上没有删除**：Windows 没有可移植的用户态回收站路径 —— 真正的回收站只能
通过 `SHFileOperation` 或 PowerShell 的 `Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem` 写入，
而后者官方注明「非用户交互的应用程序不支持 `recycle` 参数」。做不到「可还原的删除」，
本插件就**不显示删除入口**（右键菜单里没有这一项，直接调接口也会被 403 拒绝）。

这是刻意的取舍：删除的本意是清理文件，若只是把文件挪进一个自建目录，既没清掉、又让用户
以为还能从系统回收站找回，反而更容易误判。其余平台删除进**系统回收站**，可正常还原。

> 补充：macOS / Linux 上若系统回收站本身写不进去（跨分区、权限不足等），会回退到笔记根目录下的
> `dsh-notes-trash/`。该目录**不以点开头**，因此在文件树里可见、可点开、可取回 ——
> 带点的目录会被文件树隐藏，那样用户就找不回误删的文件了。

### DSH 版本与依赖

- 目标 DSH：`>=0.2.0-rc.1`
- **零三方运行时依赖**：客户端 bundle 实际只 `require` 三个平台基线模块
  （`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），
  宿主侧只用 Node 内置模块。打包脚本维护一份平台模块白名单
  （`react` / `react-dom` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis` / `dsh-client-store` /
  `dsh-client-ui-primitives` / `dsh-client-ui-slots`），**表外的模块一律不能用**，
  越界会在构建期直接报错。
- 所有槽位注册都包在 `ctx.slots.inject()` 里：**即使 DSH 未来删掉某个席位，
  插件也只是不显示，不会让启动失败。**
- 客户端 `inject` 里**必须显式声明 `remote.session`**。DSH 把每个 Remote 命名空间
  注册成独立的 cordis 服务（服务名就是 `remote.` + 命名空间名），而 cordis 的服务
  可见性按 fiber 隔离 —— 只声明 `remote` 是读不到 `remote.session` 的，会抛
  `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`。官方 `ui-open-in-app`
  同样如此声明。

# 9router-web-search

让 dsh 的 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 改走本机 **9router** 服务的搜索与抓取接口，替换内置 provider；关掉开关即可回退到 dsh 内置实现。

- 包名 / entry id / settings 命名空间：`9router-web-search`
- provider id：`9router`（搜索）、`9router-fetch`（抓取）
- 只替换 `ctx.web` 接缝的 **provider 层**：工具的 JSON schema、系统提示词、结果卡片与 UI 全部不变，模型无感

## 安装

### 推荐：从 git 安装（自带补丁，卸载干净）

```
dsh plugin add github:yifabunemgshoushi-oss/dsh-9router-web-search
```

插件通过 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`，安装时 dsh 会自动处理两件事，**不需要手改 profile**：

1. 把插件插入 Loader 行；
2. 把 `web` 接缝的 provider 指向它。

**卸载也会自动清理**：`app-boot/src/profile-plugins.ts` 的 `reconcileProfilePlugins` 会在包失去 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明（或依赖被移除）时，自动把本 bundle 从 profile 的 `bundles` 列表剔除，补丁层随之消失，`web` 行回落到 base 的默认 provider（`deepseek-official` / `http`），**不留悬空引用**。

> 这一点很关键。若插件**没有**自带补丁、而是在 profile 里手写 entry，卸载器不知道那些手写条目的存在，会残留一条指向已卸载插件的行——插件页会继续显示它，且 `web` 行留下悬空 provider id（可能触发 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`）。

### 密钥怎么给

补丁里**不写明文密钥**，只声明凭据引用：

```yaml
apiKeyEnv: NINEROUTER_API_KEY
```

插件按 `字面量 apiKey` → `credentials 域` → `启动环境变量` 的顺序解析（`lib/index.js` 的 `resolveApiKey`）。三种给法任选：

- **凭据域（推荐）**：`dsh` 的「设置 → 插件 → 9Router 网页搜索」里填 API Key，写入 `<DSH_HOME>/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs`；
- **环境变量**：设 `NINEROUTER_API_KEY`（注意要用 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的那个名字）；
- **profile 局部覆盖**：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖本行 config 补 `apiKey`。注意 `config` 是**整段替换**，须重述其余字段。

### 本地开发（`link:` 挂载）

源码目录：`D:\other\dsh-plugins\dsh-9router-web-search`（与 `dsh-mcp-manager`、`dsh-settings-extras` 同级）。

**目录名 ≠ 包名**：插件对外身份是包名 `9router-web-search`（`package.json` 的 `name`），目录上的 `dsh-` 前缀只是本地存放约定，不参与解析。profile 按**依赖键**建软链，所以依赖键必须写包名。

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条 link 依赖，再跑 `pnpm install` 生成软链：

```json
"9router-web-search": "link:D:/other/dsh-plugins/dsh-9router-web-search"
```

改用（或改用回）link 挂载时，**记得把 git 安装时期留下的 profile 手写条目一并清掉**，否则同一 `id` 会有两份定义（后者静默覆盖前者，不报错）。

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后不再调用 9router，直接走内置实现 |
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:20128` | 9router 服务地址。**不要带 `/v1`**，插件自己拼 `/v1/search`、`/v1/web/fetch` |
| `apiKey` | 空 | 9router 的 API Key。走 credentials 域存储，不写入设置文件 |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `NINEROUTER_API_KEY` | 密钥引用名；`apiKey` 为空时按此名去 credentials / 环境变量解析 |
| `searchModel` | `search-combo` | 搜索走 9router 的哪个模型/路由 |
| `fetchModel` | `fetch-combo` | 抓取走 9router 的哪个模型/路由 |
| `searchType` | `web` | 传给 `/v1/search` 的 `search_type`，详见下节 |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次搜索或抓取的最长等待时间（毫秒） |
| `fallbackToBuiltin` | `true` | 9router 调用失败时，是否自动改用内置实现重试 |

## search_type（搜索类型）

### 可选值

**`web` 与 `news` 两个**。这是 9router 自己配置表单给出的选项（`...\9router\app\.next-cli-build\server\app\(dashboard)\dashboard\media-providers\[kind]\[id]\page.js`）：

```js
{ key: "search_type", label: "Type", type: "select", default: "web", options: ["web", "news"] }
```

严格说，取值由 9router 当前那条 combo 里**每个上游 provider 的 `searchTypes` 数组**决定。`/api/v1/search` 的取值逻辑是：

```js
searchType: c.search_type || provider.searchTypes?.[0] || "web"
```

即：你没填 → 用该 provider 的第一个 → 再兜底 `"web"`。

### 有什么用

1. 选择**搜索索引类型**：`web` = 通用网页索引；`news` = 新闻/时效优先。
2. 副作用是**会影响 9router 选择哪条上游 provider**。
3. 填了不支持的值**不报错**，上游会忽略它并退回默认，试错成本低。

### 实测对比

用 `search-combo`、同一 query 实测（2026-10）：

| search_type | 实际命中的上游 | 结果特征 |
|---|---|---|
| `web` | tavily | 通用网页结果 |
| `news` | searchapi | 明显偏时事新闻 |
| `images`（非法值，用于验证） | tavily | 静默退回默认，无报错 |

### 建议

- 平时保持 `web`。
- 想要时效性强的新闻结果时切 `news`。
- 面板里清空该字段会回到插件默认值 `web`，与 9router 自身的缺省行为一致。

### 未暴露的其它 9router 参数

9router 的搜索接口还接受 `country`、`language`、`time_range`、`offset`、`domain_filter`、`content_options`、`provider_options`，但 dsh 的 web 接缝只向下传 `query` + `maxResults`，因此本插件未在面板中暴露这些字段。

## 回退语义

触发条件：`enabled = false`，或 9router 调用失败且 `fallbackToBuiltin = true`。

| 能力 | 回退实现 |
|---|---|
| 抓取 | 匿名 HTTP GET（等价 dsh 内置的 `dsh-web-fetch-http`），按 content-type 判定 `html` / `text`；非 2xx 作为**正常结果**返回而非抛错 |
| 搜索 | 等价的 DeepSeek 原生搜索（Anthropic 兼容 Messages + `web_search_20250305`）。**需要 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`**，取不到时如实报 `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`，不会编造结果 |

**为什么用常驻注册 + 开关，而不是"卸载即回退"**：`ctx.web` 的 provider 选择策略是"显式配置的 id 优先"，若插件卸载，接缝会报 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` 而不是回退。所以两个 provider 常驻注册，由 `enabled` 在**执行路径**上切换，这样一拨开关就能热回退，无需重启。

## 设置面板

位置：**设置 → 插件 → 9Router 网页搜索**。

可以改：启用开关、接口地址、API Key、密钥引用名、搜索模型、抓取模型、搜索类型、超时、失败回退开关。改完即热生效，无需重启。

> 首次安装后，Host 半会热加载生效；但**客户端面板需要重启一次 dsh** 才会出现（`dsh-client-modules` 在启动时扫描并生成 boot graph）。

### 客户端控件是自带的，不依赖 Harness Client 包

`lib/client.js` **只 require `react` 与 `react/jsx-runtime`**，设置页用到的控件（开关、取值字段、密钥字段、表单外壳、`SettingsFormModel` 表单内核）都在文件内的 `#region lib/client/ui-port.js` 里自带实现，样式经 `mountStyles()` 注入。

- **为什么不用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：官方 `references/practices.md:35` 明确禁止客户端插件 require 任何 Harness Client 包。该包虽是平台种子模块（`packages/client/web/src/seed.ts` 把它注入冻结模块表，**当前可用**），但其 API 不受 semver 约束、手写 JS 也无类型检查；一旦不兼容，失败形态是**整个 slot 条目变空白**（控制台 `slot entry crashed in '<slot>'`），而不是一个可降级的错误。自带实现后只依赖 `react` 与 `--dsw-*` token，DSH 升级最多让外观降级。
- **类名与样式**：统一加 `dsh-9rws-` 前缀以避免与宿主样式冲突；颜色只用 `--dsw-*` 主题 token。原包的 CSS Modules 已内联为 `CSS_TEXT` 常量。
- **移植范围**：只移植本插件用到的能力。原包中 `SettingsValueField` 的 `help` 信息按钮、`numeric` / `placeholder` 透传，以及各控件的 `className` / `title` 透传均未移植（本插件不需要），因此没有无测试覆盖的死代码。
- **`SettingsFormModel` 的差异**：原实现依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` 的 `createSnapshotStore`；自带版改为等价的极小实现（`subscribe` / `getSnapshot` / `set`），以彻底断开该依赖。语义（暂存编辑、保存、修订栅栏、`base`/`user` 分层、overridden 判定）完全保留。

## 维护提示

- **源码目录与挂载方式**：源码在 `D:\other\dsh-plugins\dsh-9router-web-search`（2026-10-16 从 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/9router-web-search` 迁出并改名），通过 profile 的 `link:` 依赖挂载，`node_modules/9router-web-search` 是指向它的软链。改代码后重启 dsh 生效；**不要**把源码目录改回非 link 的实体副本，否则 profile 里会出现第二份、与源码不同步的拷贝。
- **依赖由宿主供给，仓库不携带 `node_modules`**：`package.json` 把插件**直接 import 的 4 个包**声明为 `peerDependencies` 与 `devDependencies` 各一份——`@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-launch-environment`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。
  - peer 让 profile 解析器用**运行中 dsh 安装里的那一份**占据该包名，**即使插件目录下没有物理 `node_modules` 也成立**（见 `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts` 的 `routeLinked`：读 importer 祖先链上每层 manifest 的 `peerDependencies` 来判定拦截）。dev 副本供编译器/独立测试使用，运行时不会被加载。
  - **必须共用同一实例**：`lib/index.js` 用 `error instanceof WebError` 判定错误，两侧各自复制一份会让该判定静默失效。
  - 其余传递依赖（`cosmokit`、`cordis`、`dsh-brand`、`dsh-llm`、`zod` 等）由宿主**安装闭包**提供（`app.asar` 内共 289 个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包），无需声明。
  - `node_modules/` 与 `temp-dsh/` 已加入 `.gitignore`。本地若仍留有旧的实体副本，声明 peer 后运行时已优先走宿主那一份，副本只是冗余（可删）。
  - **升级 dsh 后**若出现模块缺失或 API 不存在，核对两个不变量：① `package.json` 里 peer 声明的每个包名，都仍出现在 dsh 安装闭包中（`app.asar` 内 `dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*`，本次核对时共 289 个）；② 插件直接 import 的每个包名都已声明 peer。历史上 `profiles/node_modules` 曾是指向 **npm 版 dsh** `0.1.0-rc.7` 的 junction 农场，那套缺 `schemastery.volatile()` 与 `dsh-credentials.isCredentialRefName`，加载会崩；该农场已于 2026-10-13 清理。
- **分发方式**：本地开发用 profile 的 `link:` 依赖（见上）。要装到别的机器，走 git 源（`dsh plugin add github:<用户>/dsh-9router-web-search`），由插件管理器在 profile 内跑 pnpm 安装依赖。**`lib/` 必须提交**：安装前会预检 `exports` 指向的文件真实存在，缺构建产物会直接判为失败。
- **命名空间即 entry id**：settings 命名空间等于 profile 里的 entry id。若要改名，`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `id`、`lib/index.js` 的 `name`、`lib/client.js` 的 bundle `id` 与 `ROUTER_NS` 必须一起改；旧命名空间下面板写入的用户层配置会变成孤儿。
- **桌面版契约**：本插件按 dsh **0.2.0-rc.2** 的接口编写（`config.<field>.get()` 形式的 volatile 配置、`ctx.configForms` 设置面板、`plugins.item` 槽位）。用于更早的 npm 版 dsh 需要按旧 API 改写。

pnpm install + build
link: 注册"] I --> H["回读 loader entry
bundle / client 半"] B --> H H --> O["如实告知：刷新 / 重启 / 已生效"] ``` ## 先装一次，之后都能一句话 第一次仍需把 resolver 装进来（约 10 秒）；从下一次安装开始，用户只需要说"帮我装 xxx"。 - 官方版：`插件 → 实验性插件 → 打开自定义插件市场 → 发现 → 添加索引源`（URL 见下），安装 `dsh-plugin-resolver`； - 或者 CLI（profile 名以你的 DSH 安装为准）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-resolver ``` 装完重启一次宿主；之后： > "帮我装 dsh-browser" → 列出 6 个同名候选，要求 `owner=`，不猜； > "装 dsh-builtin-browser" → 选到与你内核兼容的版本并装好。 明确的包直接装；歧义名、GitHub 源码、未知来源会先给出解析计划。它不是插件市场的替代品，而是"把安装交给 agent"的那条路径。 ## 三种安装方式（任选） 要求 **DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`**（已在 `engines.dsh` 声明）。纯 JS、无构建、无 install 脚本，三种方式都不需要 `allowBuilds` 授权： ```sh # npm（已发布 0.1.2；profile 名以你的 DSH 安装为准） dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-resolver # GitHub 源码安装（建议锁 commit） dsh plugin --profile add github:sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver# # tarball npm pack && dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-plugin-resolver-0.1.2.tgz ``` 插件市场（Discover）索引（在插件页打开实验性「自定义插件市场」，然后 `插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源`）： ```text https://sakikoTGW.github.io/dsh-plugin-resolver/market/index.json ``` 真实调用长这样： ```text $ plugin_resolve dsh-builtin-browser target kind: npm running DSH: 0.2.1-rc.2 package: dsh-builtin-browser@0.4.13 install spec: dsh-builtin-browser@0.4.13 registry: https://registry.npmmirror.com/ notes: - newest published version whose DSH peer range accepts the running host ``` ```text $ plugin_resolve dsh-better-sidebar package: dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 install spec: dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 ``` ## 四个工具 | 工具 | 作用 | 是否改动环境 | |---|---|---| | `plugin_search` | 搜社区目录（npm 载体优先），排序并显式标出同名歧义 | 只读 | | `plugin_resolve` | 只解析不装：目录条目、兼容版本、registry、是否需要源码构建 | 只读 | | `plugin_install` | 完整安装：选版本 → 安装/构建 → 回读校验 → 下一步提示 | 写 profile | | `plugin_status` | 已装 bundle / loader entry / fiberPhase 盘点 | 只读 | ## 版本选择规则 1. 运行时版本 = `pluginManager.listBundles()` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 的版本； 2. 逐版本从高到低检查：非可选 **`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`** peer 必须满足运行时版本；声明了 **`engines.dsh`** 也要满足； 3. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 等**同命名空间但不同版本线**的库**不算**运行时约束（这条曾把 4/8 个包误判成"无兼容版本"，见 [ABLATION](ABLATION.md)）； 4. 取第一个通过者；全不通过时列出最近版本的拒绝原因；用户显式给 `version` 时跳过求解。 ## 安装路径 - **registry 包**：`pluginManager.installBundle(name@resolved, { registry })`，profile/lockfile/激活生命周期都交给插件管理器； - **GitHub-only**：检出到 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-sources/__`，缺构建产物且声明了 `build` 时执行 `pnpm install` + `pnpm run build`，随后 `installBundle('link:')`，已构建的检出直接复用； - **显式 spec**（`github:` / `link:` / `file:` / `https:`）：原样交给插件管理器。 ## 重启判定 `plugin_install` 不再无条件要求重启；安装前后会比较： - `pluginManager.listBundles()` 的 bundle 集合 - 已安装包运行时文件的 hash（排除 README / docs / 版本号） 结果： - 无变化 / 仅版本号变化 / 管理器已就地应用 → `restart: not required` - bundle 新增、运行时代码变化、client 半变化 → `restart: required — <原因>` 本插件自身的 `logic/` 改动可以按 mtime 热加载，不需要重启；新增 bundle 或宿主壳变化仍然必须重启。 ## 结构：稳定壳 + 可热加载逻辑 ``` index.js 宿主入口（稳定） host/register.js 工具 schema + pluginManager 桥接（稳定，改动需重启） logic/ 目录 / 版本 / 兼容 / 安装编排（每次调用按 mtime 重新 import） ``` `host/register.js` 每次调用计算 `logic/` 下最大 mtime，以 `import('./logic/api.js?v=')` 导入；逻辑模块之间用同一 `?v=` 传递依赖。Node 的 ESM 缓存按完整 URL 计，因此： - **改 `logic/` 任何文件 → 下一次工具调用立即生效，不用重启宿主** - 只有改动工具定义层（`index.js` / `host/register.js`）才需要重启 这是为无 HMR 的打包运行环境设计的：宿主拿不到真 HMR 所需的 Node 内部模块加载器，但"重新 import 一个带新 query 的模块"完全可行。 ## 效果 | 指标 | agent 手工路径（未装 resolver） | 本插件 | 来源 | |---|---|---|---| | 工具调用（装 1 歧义 + 1 GitHub-only 插件） | ≈ 45 次 | **≈ 6 次** | [BENCHMARK](BENCHMARK.md) | | 决策链耗时 | — | **1.05 s / 9 个决策任务** | benchmark.mjs（官方 0.2.1-rc.2） | | 目录获取 | 91.06 s / 6.4 MB | **0.86 s / 2 请求** | benchmark.mjs（官方 0.2.1-rc.2） | | 安装失败重试 | 2 次 90 s 超时 | **0 次** | 会话日志 | | 安装后校验调用 | 2 次额外探测 | **0 次** | benchmark.mjs | > 基线是 **agent 手工流程**，不是官方 Discover 的点击次数：对点 UI 的人市场已经够用，这个插件服务的是把安装交给 agent 的人。 消融测试（逐项拆能力）见 [ABLATION.md](ABLATION.md)：同名 287 组、naive 会选错 51 组；8 个真实包中 2 个 latest 不兼容；镜像元数据延迟比 59.6–78.8×（随线路波动）；GitHub-only 入口探针 404；静默失败可检测；逻辑热加载 2 ms vs 重启 30–40 s。 ```sh node test/benchmark.mjs # 插件路径基准 node test/ablation.mjs # 消融测试（无副作用） ``` ## 测试与 CI ```sh npm test # = selftest(25) + harness(10) npm run bench # 基准 npm run ablate # 消融 ``` - `test/selftest.mjs`：semver 子集、版本选择、spec 解析、目录检索（离线） - `test/harness.mjs`：假 Cordis ctx + 假 pluginManager 驱动真实工具体 - `test/benchmark.mjs` / `test/ablation.mjs`：真实目录 + 真实 registry 的测量脚本 - CI：每次 push 跑 `test`；`ablation` 走手动/每周定时任务 ## 已知限制 - 兼容性以 npm 元数据里的 peer / `engines.dsh` 为准，宿主启动预检另有判断时以宿主为准； - **替换已加载插件**仍需要重启宿主（loader 模块缓存 + 打包宿主无 Node 内部 loader）；**新增 bundle** 只看管理器的应用结果：管理器就地应用（HMR 重组合）时不再报 `restart-required`，只有它自己要求重启时才报；带 client 半的新插件会额外提示刷新 GUI； - 同名歧义不猜，需要调用方给 `owner=` 或完整 spec； - 目录是社区维护的第三方列表，插件只保证"按声明来源装对版本"，不做安全审计； - GitHub 源码构建依赖宿主环境里的 `pnpm`（PATH 或 `DSH_PNPM_PATH`）与 `tar`，大仓库首次构建较慢。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: One DSH composer plugin: direct model picker, draggable reasoning-effort rail, and a DeepSeek account hider. DSH 输入框三合一插件：模型选择 + 拖动强度条 + 隐藏 DeepSeek 账号
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-composer-plus

One plugin, four things: model picker + draggable reasoning-effort rail + DeepSeek account hider + right-click file actions.

中文 | English

## What it is `dsh-composer-plus` is a pure front-end plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) **web client**. It folds the composer's right-hand controls into one pill: | Feature | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Model picker** | Click the model name to get a provider-grouped list (no submenu). A pick applies immediately. | | **Effort rail (drag bar)** | A notched slider: click, drag, or use `←`/`→`/`Home`/`End`. Levels come from each model's own `reasoningEfforts`; the top level gets a gradient sweep and halo. | | **Hide DeepSeek account** | The bundle patch disables the official account entry (sidebar account menu, account settings page, credential onboarding), and the custom model menu filters the `deepseek-account` channel. | | **File context menu** | Right-click a changed-files card, a delivered file card, a file-tree row, or a rendered file-path link: open it in the sidebar or show it in Finder (Explorer / the default file manager on other platforms). | | **Theme-aware** | Every color binds to `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, so light/dark and third-party skins stay readable. | | **Zero intrusion** | A modular bundle: no core changes, nothing written outside the profile, clean removal. | The file menu reuses shipped capabilities: the target's own click, the `shell.overlay` / `Menu` / `Toast` primitives, and the Session Remote's `openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })` (the Host runs `open -R` on macOS), so it adds no host route.

## Compatibility - dsh **0.1.5+** (the `ctx.modelDirectories` / `session/selectModel` generation) and a **web client** (`dsh web`, or the web UI inside the desktop app). - End-to-end tested on dsh **0.2.1-rc.2**: model switching, drag + keyboard effort changes, light/dark themes, no account entry in Settings, and the file context menu. - The rail only appears for models that declare reasoning levels; other models show the picker alone. - The plugin draws into the composer's `conversation.input.right` seat and tucks the native model trigger away. If a future dsh changes the composer DOM and the native trigger is not hidden, please open an issue. - The file menu recognizes dsh's DOM contracts (`data-changed-files`, `data-presented-file`, `data-files-path/entry`, and path-link buttons carrying a `title`). If a later dsh renames one, the menu stays quiet instead of hijacking unrelated right-clicks. ## Install ### Web profile (`dsh web`) ```sh # straight from GitHub — no npm account needed dsh plugin --profile web add github:WuweiRE/dsh-composer-plus ``` Or clone and install the local directory: ```sh git clone https://github.com/WuweiRE/dsh-composer-plus.git dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-composer-plus ``` Restart `dsh web` (or `dsh --profile web`) once and refresh the page. Later client-only updates usually need just a refresh. ### Desktop app The desktop profile is managed by the Electron app (`dsh plugin --profile desktop` is refused). Install this bundle from the app's **Plugins** page (GitHub repo or a local directory), then restart the app. If your build has no such entry, validate on a web profile first and point the app at that profile. > The plugin participates in profile composition, so install/remove needs one app restart; CSS/client-only changes only need a refresh. ## Configuration All three switches are on by default and live in the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: ui-composer-plus name: dsh-composer-plus config: hideAccount: true # account menu / account settings page / credential onboarding + leftover rows hideAccountModels: true # filter the deepseek-account channel from the custom model menu fileActions: true # right-click file menu (open in sidebar / show in Finder) ``` To bring the official account UI back, override the row in **your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`** and delete these two patches, which are what actually close the account page: ```yaml - id: ui-settings-account disabled: true - id: ui-settings-models name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models' config: credentialOnboarding: false ``` ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-plus ``` Then restart `dsh web` / the app. The plugin stores no runtime data; the last selected effort stays in dsh's own session state. ## Layout ```text dsh-composer-plus/ ├─ package.json # bundle + web client manifest (immediately / inject) ├─ cordis.patch.yml # account hider patches + plugin row ├─ lib/index.js # host half: publishes options as window.__DSH_COMPOSER_PLUS__ ├─ lib/client.js # browser half: pill, model menu, rail, account-row hider, file context menu ├─ locale/{zh,en}.json # plugin-manager title/description ├─ icon.svg # plugin icon ├─ test/context-menu.smoke.mjs # Node smoke test for the file context menu (npm test) └─ docs/*.png # README screenshots ``` There is no build step: `lib/client.js` is a browser-executed `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` factory and React comes from the dsh module table. ## Known limits - Account hiding is **patch-layer disable + client-side fallback**: another plugin that re-adds account UI can override it; disable that plugin first. - The account-model filter only affects this plugin's menu; the native `/model` popup is still dsh's (use it to pick an account model temporarily). - Web client only; headless/TUI profiles never render the composer. - The file menu only acts on file elements the UI already renders; a plain-text path in a message that is neither a link nor a file card gets no menu. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE). Third-party credits: [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vault

**English** · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

**Encrypted full backup and restore for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@lingfengmow/dsh-vault.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lingfengmow/dsh-vault)
[![install](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-github%3Asoberkeen%2Fdsh--vault-2ea043.svg)](https://github.com/soberkeen/dsh-vault)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

> Packs **config / sessions / skills / plugins / workspaces / Hindsight memory / the DSH client installer** into
> **encrypted, chunked volumes**, written to a local directory and optionally pushed to a NAS (network share or WebDAV).
> Every package carries a **self-contained restorer** and a recovery ledger inside it, with GFS rotation and optional
> scheduled backups.
>
> **Zero build step · zero external dependencies**: the pure-ESM JavaScript under `lib/` *is* the source and the
> artifact. Only `node:` builtins are used — no 7z, no openssl, no rclone, no npm dependency — so it installs on any
> machine that runs DSH.
>
> Status (2026-10-17): **verified**. Real packages `core` (599 MB) and `full_all` (711 MB) both pass `verify`
> (plaintext hash and per-volume hashes agree) and `restore-drill` (30/30, 31/31). Runs on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, with the
> settings panel, all six tools and the HTTP API exercised in a real injected session. Contract **checked against
> `0.2.1-rc.2`** — see [docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md](./docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md) (9 contracts, 8 unchanged, 1 additive).

---

## 1. Install

### From npm (recommended)

```powershell
# Official DSH CLI — maintains dependencies + lockfile + node_modules + profile bundles
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin add "@lingfengmow/dsh-vault"

# Pin a profile when you run more than one
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "@lingfengmow/dsh-vault"
```

Published as `@lingfengmow/dsh-vault@0.2.0` — 45 files, 532 KB unpacked, `sha1 aa815b930a302d3327a786b9ddfa3e7813958032`.

### From GitHub (equivalent — `lib/` is plain ESM with no build step)

```powershell
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault
```

Then **fully quit DSH and start it again** (not the "restart" button on the crash dialog). A **Backup** entry appears
in the settings sidebar when it worked.

### Local development

```powershell
# Hot injection, no restart (needs dsh-super-injector)
dev_inject_plugin  -dir "<absolute path to this directory>"

# Or write it into the profile (assembled from bundles on restart)
dev_install_package -dir "<absolute path to this directory>" -profile desktop

# Pack a tgz for another machine (no build step; the tgz is the artifact)
npm pack
```

**Requires**: DSH ≥ 0.2.0, Node ≥ 18 (the DSH runtime is enough), pwsh 7 (only for `restore.ps1`).
**Does not require**: 7z / openssl / gpg / rclone / any npm dependency. Docker is used only when backing up Hindsight's
Postgres database (`docker exec … pg_dump`).

### Self-check after installing

```powershell
npm run check                            # syntax gate
node scripts/client-register-test.mjs    # client registration contract, 8 assertions, must be all green
node scripts/health-check.mjs            # 15 runtime checks
```

---

## 2. Six tools (the AI-facing entry points)

| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_scan` | Scan and preview by importance tier (P0 must-keep / P1 optional / P2 excluded), **no side effects** | `scope`, `includeP1`, `topExcluded` |
| `vault_backup` | Run an encrypted backup and write it out | `password`, `outDir`, `scope`, `includeP1`, `dryRun` |
| `vault_list` | List historical packages (grouping volumes of one logical package) | `dir` |
| `vault_verify` | Full decrypt plus plaintext/volume hash check (writes nothing) | `package` (required), `password` |
| `vault_restore` | Restore: unpack to `--target`, or restore in place | `package` (required), `password`, `target`, `inPlace`, `only`, `list` |
| `vault_prune` | GFS rotation (dry-run by default, prints the delete list) | `dir`, `apply`, `hardDelete`, `keepLast`, `maxTotalGB` |

> Tool schemas are guarded by `scripts/schema-gate.mjs`: top-level `type:'object'`, `required` a top-level array of
> strings, and **no** boolean `required` inside property nodes. Historically an invalid schema made whole
> DeepSeek/mimo sessions return 400.

---

## 3. Scripts (the command-line entry points, all dependency-free)

```powershell
cd <this directory>

# ── Gates and regressions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/schema-gate.mjs      # tool schema gate (must pass before registering; wired into build.sh) → 6 tools + required semantics PASS
node scripts/policy-test.mjs      # GFS retention unit tests (10 cases: minKeep/keepLast/day-week-month buckets/size cap/chain protection/trash) → 10/10
node scripts/boundary-test.mjs    # boundaries and robustness (11 cases: empty dir/zero bytes/20MiB spanning frames/long paths LongLink/Unicode/multi-volume/missing volume/tampering/wrong password/per-file hashes/corrupt header) → 11/11
node scripts/selftest.mjs "G:\DSH-Backup\_selftest"   # end to end (scan→pack→verify→unpack→negative cases) → 12/12

# ── Real runs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --dry                                  # estimate only (strongly recommended first)
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup"                  # core: config+sessions+memory+installer+plugins+orchestration
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup" --scope all      # also include workspaces (02-workspaces)

# ── Verify and drill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$key = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\_keys\*.key.txt" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
$pkg = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\*.vault" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key           # verify (password read from the key file)
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key --target D:\vault-check   # also unpack to compare
$pw = (Select-String -Path $key -Pattern '^密码：(.+)$').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim()
node scripts/restore-drill.mjs --package $pkg --password $pw          # clean-machine restore drill (five-way cross-check, no side effects by default)
```

**Build**: `bash scripts/build.sh` — for a zero-build package this only runs the `node --check` syntax gate, the
schema gate and a required-files existence check.

---

## 4. Password and key policy

| Source | Priority | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `--password <value>` | 1 | Explicit; shows up in the process command line, fine for a one-off local run |
| Env var `DSHVAULT_PASSWORD` (name configurable) | 2 | Suitable for scripts and scheduled jobs |
| Generated automatically | 3 | When `core-drop.mjs` gets no password it generates a **policy-compliant random** one (leading capital + special character + ≥8 chars), prints it once on stdout and **writes it nowhere by default**; pass `--write-key` to persist it to `<out>/_keys/<package>.key.txt` |

- **A key file is a decryption credential**: leaking it means the package can be opened. Move it somewhere safe, or copy
  it down and delete it.
- **A lost password means the package is unrecoverable** (AES-256-GCM, no backdoor, no recovery channel).
- The password is **never** written into the manifest, into documents inside the package, or into logs.

---

## 5. Backup scope and exclusion rules

**Partitions**

| Partition | Contents |
|---|---|
| `00-installer` | The DSH client installer (the prerequisite for restoring onto a bare machine; **exempt from the L4 large-binary rule**) |
| `01-dsh-home` | `$DSH_HOME`: config / sessions / skills / rules / storage (excludes `node_modules`, `cache`, `plugin-bac

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: normalize tool schemas before the model request (fixes Gemini functionDeclarations 400s from any MCP or built-in tool)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gemini-tool-schema

> Normalize the tool schemas sent to the model into the **strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini's function declarations accept**. A TypeScript plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-gemini-tool-schema)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](LICENSE)
[![ci](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## The problem

Strict providers accept only a *subset* of JSON Schema. Google Gemini's `functionDeclarations[].parameters` rejects the **whole request** (HTTP 400) when:

| Real error | Offending schema | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema didn't specify the schema type field` | `{ anyOf: [{type:'string',…}, {type:'null'}] }` — no `type` | Playwright MCP `browser_emulate_media.colorScheme` (`z.string().nullable()`) |
| `properties[v_types].items: missing field` | `{ type: 'array' }` — no `items` | Lingshu MCP `lingshu_cg` / `lingshu_stg` (19 params) |
| `properties[permission].enum[3]: cannot be empty` | `enum: [..., '']` | DSH built-in `task_board_update.permission` |

All three are legal elsewhere, which is why the failure only shows up on a Gemini-flavoured route.

## Why a Harness hook

An MCP proxy only reaches the servers it wraps. Built-in tools and tools registered by other plugins never cross an MCP transport, so normalizing at Harness assembly time is the only fix that covers **every** tool at once.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.git
cd dsh-gemini-tool-schema && npm install && npm run build
```

Append to `<DSH home>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gemini-tool-schema
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/dist/index.js'
      config:
        mode: list
        apis: ['gemini', 'google', 'vertex']
```

Or `npm install dsh-gemini-tool-schema` and mount it by package name.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `list` | `all` every request · `list` matching APIs only · `off` disabled |
| `apis` | `['gemini','google','vertex']` | API patterns, **compiled as regular expressions** |
| `unknownApi` | `apply` | When the route cannot be read: `apply` or `skip` |
| `itemsFallback` | `{type:'string'}` | Element schema for arrays that omit `items` |
| `nullable` | `true` | Emit `nullable: true` for null unions |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Report and lint, but send the original schemas |
| `logFile` / `logLevel` | none / `info` | One diagnostic line per assembly |
| `dumpDir` / `dumpSchemas` | none / `true` | Dump the model-facing tool set for offline auditing |

Patterns match against `provider/model` (e.g. `gemini-lumiya/gemini-4-argon`) and accept substring, regex, and `/pattern/flags` forms; an entry that does not compile degrades to a case-insensitive substring match. `'*'` matches everything, or set `mode: all`.

## Rules

Every node gets a `type`; every array gets `items`; `enum` entries are never empty (and `const` cannot reintroduce one); `$ref`/`$defs` are inlined cycle-safely; unsupported keywords are stripped and the remaining scalars pass an allow-list; `required` is narrowed to real properties.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # Node ≥22.6 runs the TS tests directly — 36 tests
npm run build   # tsc → dist/
```

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 -
